question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**prevent**" means to stop something from happening or arising. (रोकना)
 
• Safe drinking water can indeed prevent many water-related diseases, making it the most appropriate choice for the blank.
 
• The other options: "**forbid**," "**restrain**," and "**hamper**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Not only is it necessary for us to be able to meet our daily needs but safe drinking water can prevent__ many water-related diseases.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Forbid (मनाई करना)**: means to refuse to allow something. This is not as relevant in the context of disease prevention.
 
• **Restrain (अवरुद्ध करना)**: means to hold back or keep under control. This does not fit well in the context of preventing diseases.
 
• **Hamper (बाधा डालना)**: means to hinder or impede the movement or progress of something. This is opposite to what is needed in the context.
